newsitem.title: FINLAND: LIPPONEN SAYS THINKS GOVT PARTIES WANT TO RULE ON.
newsitem.headline: LIPPONEN SAYS THINKS GOVT PARTIES WANT TO RULE ON.

text.p: Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen said on Wednesday he believed all five parties in his rainbow government wanted the coalition to remain in office.

"Now all government parties ... must decide whether we shall continue, shall we play by the rules, shall we stand by what has been agreed or shall we go home and let others take over?" Lipponen said in a television interview on Wednesday evening.
"And I think, based on talks, that all government parties are willing to continue," he added.
Lipponen was referring to a parliamentary vote of confidence in the left-right-green government due in February.

The coming confidence vote, linked to a once-defeated but later reintroduced government proposal to liberalise retail store opening hours, will be the fifth since the Lipponen cabinet took office in April for a four-year term.
